integrity: An all-parameter elementary simplicial-collapse proof is included. Independent shortest-path face enumeration and binary homology agree for orders six through sixteen; these finite tests do not substitute for the all-order proof.
scientific_limitations: Only one additional deleted edge in cocktail-party graphs of order at least six; no multiple-edge, other multipartite part-size, weighted metric, or equivariant claim. Independent mathematical audit has not been performed.
title: One-edge collapse of the general-position complex of cocktail-party graphs
